rulesText:
Combat Phase and Rules

1. The Character with the highest INI begins. Choose a combat action for that character: attack, move or take no action.

2. When attacking, the character is turned. The opponent may now choose a defender with an available action. In general, a character can only act when it is not turned.

3. After resolving, the character with the next highest INI acts, and so on.

4. Repeat this process lane by lane. Note: All combat actions are determined by the characters' INI values.

Abilities from permanent cards (e.g. Equipment, Training, Artifacts) may be activated at any time.

Important: If a character is turned, it loses its RES and INI until it is unturned.
